Page(
  name: "Product options",
  route: Route(path: "/stores/$storeId/products/$productId"),

      Text(child: product.name, size: FontSize.xxl, align: TextAlign.center),
      Text(child: formatMoney(product.display_price_cents), letterSpacing: 2, color: Color.primary, align: TextAlign.center),
      Text(child: product.description, size: FontSize.sm, color: Color.textMuted, align: TextAlign.center),
      ForEach(items: choices.groups, as: "group", child: Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [
        Box(height: 1, background: Color.border),
        Text(child: group.label, size: FontSize.xs, weight: FontWeight.bold, letterSpacing: 2, color: Color.primary),
        Text(child: group.single ? "Choose one" : "Up to ${group.max}", color: Color.textMuted, size: FontSize.xs),
        ForEach(items: group.choices, as: "choice", child: Box(padding: Insets(y: 8), onTap: ToggleOption(group: group.id, choice: choice.id), ariaLabel: choice.label, child: Row(gap: Space.md, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center, children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: choice.label, color: choice.selected ?       ])),
      Row(gap: Space.xl, mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center, children: [
        Box(onTap: SetState(state: "quantity", value: state.quantity > 1 ? state.quantity - 1 : 1), ariaLabel: "Fewer", child: Icon(name: Icons.minus, color: Color.primary)),
        Text(child: state.quantity, size: FontSize.xl, letterSpacing: 2),
        Box(onTap: SetState(state: "quantity", value: state.quantity + 1), ariaLabel: "More", child: Icon(name: Icons.plus, color: Color.primary))
      ]),
      Button(label: "${"Add to cone"} · ${formatMoney((product.display_price_cents + choices.addon_price_cents) * state.quantity)}", style: ButtonStyle.secondary, fullWidth: true, disabled: !product.is_available, onTap: AddConfiguredProduct(quantity: state.quantity))
    ]), else: Text(child: "Choose something from the menu.", size: FontSize.sm, color: Color.textMuted))
  ])])),
  )
)
